question: We need an audit firm and an integration partner for a Stellar launch. Where are vetted service providers and anchors for Stellar listed?

golden.answer: SDF lists service providers at stellar.org/ecosystem/service-providers, grouped by type: developer services, infrastructure and white-label, analytics, tokenization, and audit partners. Anchors are listed in the Anchor Directory at anchors.stellar.org. For contract audits, the Soroban Security Audit Bank publishes its pre-approved audit firms. Rosters change, so read the live pages.
keyFacts: SDF publishes a service providers directory at stellar.org/ecosystem/service-providers.
The Anchor Directory at anchors.stellar.org lists Stellar anchors.
The Soroban Security Audit Bank publishes its pre-approved audit firms.
golden.notes: Live. Accept another maintained partner directory when it is named with its source. Do not require a list of firms.

activation.author: gap lanes gap-1, gap-2, gap-3 (Claude Fable 5.2)

truth.notes: SDF page sections observed 2026-11-14: PwC; Developer services (Aha Labs, ArmenoTech, BP Ventures, Cheesecake Labs, DCM, IntellectEU, Leeway Hertz, Relevance Labs, Settle, SoftServe, VMware Tanzu Labs, 57Blocks); Infrastructure & whitelabel services; Analytics companies; Tokenization services; Audit partners (Certora). Scout's own partner directory returned 43 published partners (21 anchors, 5 audit firms, no agency rows). The SDF page was not surfaced by any Raven source.
